name: legacy
summary: Adopting Meerkat on old code: accept everything that is there today, then report and fail only on what is new.

scope.detail: the whole project, but only findings that are not in the baseline count

notes: Run `meerkat verify` once, read it, then `meerkat baseline` to accept all of it. Fix old findings at your own pace and run `meerkat baseline` again to shrink the list.
`meerkat hook install` runs the quick preset with --ratchet before every push.
